content.content:
We need to create 5-day itinerary, departing from Grand Junction (Colorado) heading to 2 cities in Arizona. Dates March 19-23 2022. No flights, so presumably drive. Need private rooms accommodation for visitors (maybe hotels, Airbnbs). Budget $2100 total for two people. Need to include transportation (driving), meals, attractions. The tool submit_day_plan expects fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. For each day we must call submit_day_plan. We need to decide which two cities in Arizona: maybe Phoenix and Sedona or Flagstaff and Sedona. Starting from Grand Junction, drive to first city, spend some days, then travel to second city, then return maybe? Not required to return. We'll create itinerary:

Day 1 March 19: Grand Junction to Flagstaff (drive ~5h). Transportation: "Drive, Grand Junction to Flagstaff, Departure 08:00, Arrival 13:00". Breakfast maybe at home (or on road). Attraction: maybe Lowell Observatory? Actually that's in Flagstaff. We'll list a few attractions.

Day 2 March 20: Flagstaff (stay). Day activities: Grand Canyon South Rim day trip (drive). Could be attraction: Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona. Lunch there. Dinner in Flagstaff.

Day 3 March 21: Flagstaff to Sedona (drive 45 min). Transportation. Attractions: Red Rock State Park, Sedona. Lunch.

Day 4 March 22: Sedona day: Slide Rock State Park, Chapel of the Holy Cross.

Day 5 March 23: Sedona to Grand Junction or maybe to Phoenix? But need 5 days ending March 23. Could end in Phoenix after Sedona? But we have only two AZ cities: Flagstaff and Sedona. So day 5 maybe return to Grand Junction (drive ~6h). Transportation: drive back.

Need accommodation private rooms: maybe mid-range hotels ~$120/night each. 5 nights total cost $600. Meals budget maybe $30 per person per day = $60*5 = $300. Gas budget maybe $200. Total under $2100.

We need to call submit_day_plan for each day (5 calls). Provide required fields.

We must not ask follow-up. So we generate plan and call function.

We need to fill fields: breakfast (restaurant), attraction (list ; separated with Name, City), lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We'll assume breakfast at a local café, etc.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
